cases.title: Trace without AI
cases.given: Given a validated analysis response, capture its receipt, hash it and render the standard explanation.
cases.expected: Provider spy count remains zero for capture/hash/render; usage comes from the existing response.

cases.title: Exact reuse
cases.given: Same public project, task, complete input, versions and fresh dependencies.
cases.expected: Same artifact returned; new reuse receipt; zero new model calls.

cases.title: Model change
cases.given: Change model/config/prompt/parser independently while keeping facts identical.
cases.expected: Each incompatible change prevents reuse with explicit reason.

cases.title: Expired analysis
cases.given: Set now equal to valid_until_ms.
cases.expected: Not reusable; historical display remains possible with stale marker.

cases.title: Scoped privacy
cases.given: Same content requested in public scope and user-private scope.
cases.expected: Private artifact never satisfies a public lookup or another user's lookup.

cases.title: Market-only change
cases.given: Engineering request excludes market facts by contract; liquidity changes.
cases.expected: Recalculate market eligibility locally, reuse fresh engineering artifact; zero new AI calls.

cases.title: Hidden dependency
cases.given: Actual engineering prompt contains market cap and market cap changes.
cases.expected: Request hash changes and artifact cannot be reused; no false isolation.

cases.title: Commit change
cases.given: A critical code dependency changes after request capture.
cases.expected: Invalidate dependent artifact; unaffected unrelated analysis can remain valid.

cases.title: Late completion
cases.given: Generation 1 running; generation 2 input appears; generation 1 completes.
cases.expected: Store generation 1 historically but reject applying it to generation 2.

cases.title: Concurrent duplicate
cases.given: Two workers request identical request_hash/scope/generation with valid lease.
cases.expected: One provider call in ordinary successful flow; second waits/reuses. Test with shared DB, not process-local lock only.

cases.title: Lease takeover
cases.given: Old worker's lease expires; new owner receives higher fencing token.
cases.expected: Old worker cannot publish current projection even if it finishes later.

cases.title: Ambiguous provider timeout
cases.given: Provider may have completed before transport timeout.
cases.expected: Persist ambiguous status; bounded retry policy; never claim exactly-once cost.

cases.title: Atomic capture
cases.given: Fail receipt insert after artifact insert in one transaction.
cases.expected: No partially committed reusable artifact; retry storage does not invoke AI.

cases.title: Invalid output
cases.given: Provider returns malformed or schema-invalid response.
cases.expected: Not reusable as validated; short failure cache does not mark project poor.

cases.title: Changed policy replay
cases.given: New deterministic scoring policy, original required inputs available.
cases.expected: Offline recomputation yields new simulation receipt; active ranking untouched; zero model calls.

cases.title: Missing replay data
cases.given: New policy requires evidence absent at original cutoff.
cases.expected: incomplete_replay; no present-day fetch or hidden AI call.

cases.title: Integrity mismatch
cases.given: Stored payload bytes no longer match receipt hash.
cases.expected: Verifier reports integrity failure; does not repair with a model.

cases.title: Threat boundary
cases.given: Database and all hashes replaced consistently by administrator.
cases.expected: Documentation makes no independent tamper-proof claim; local verifier alone cannot establish historical authenticity.

cases.title: Revoked source
cases.given: Invalidate a source dependency while cached artifact remains within TTL.
cases.expected: Reuse denied despite TTL, with reason SOURCE_REVOKED or RIGHTS_UNKNOWN as applicable.

cases.title: Canonicalization
cases.given: Reorder object keys; vary null vs absent vs zero; retain array order; include NaN.
cases.expected: Object-key reorder stable; meaningful variants differ; NaN rejected.

cases.title: Identity preservation
cases.given: Use two distinct case-sensitive Solana identifiers and two canonical EVM representations.
cases.expected: No Solana case collapse; EVM handled only by validated chain normalizer.

cases.title: Legacy import
cases.given: Legacy cache lacks reconstructible exact input and version provenance.
cases.expected: legacy_unverified; not silently promoted into reusable cache.

cases.title: Payload deletion
cases.given: Remove retained payload using authorized retention/tombstone flow.
cases.expected: Receipt remains explainable as missing payload; replay_unavailable, not verified computation.

cases.title: Budget exhaustion
cases.given: Task lacks fresh artifact and AI budget is exhausted.
cases.expected: queued_budget, no hidden call; critical deterministic safety checks still run.

cases.title: Budget bound safety
cases.given: Ordinary criterion cannot change threshold under a proven bound; separate safety task pending.
cases.expected: May defer ordinary task only; safety task and exploration quota not suppressed.

cases.title: Counterfactual explanation
cases.given: Two required gates fail; one threshold improves.
cases.expected: Explain remaining blocker; never promise admission from only one necessary condition.

cases.title: Duplicate receipt
cases.given: Same event idempotency key submitted twice; then same key with different content.
cases.expected: Same-content retry idempotent; changed-content conflict; no duplicate decision.

cases.title: Shadow mode
cases.given: Enable observation on existing pipeline.
cases.expected: No additional model calls; tracing storage failure exposed in metrics without triggering another AI call.

cases.title: Clock rollback
cases.given: Persisted artifact expiry is reached, then wall clock moves backward.
cases.expected: No automatic un-expiry; time anomaly handled conservatively and recorded.

cases.title: Real call accounting
cases.given: One decision uses nested AI task; provider usage missing in one response.
cases.expected: Do not display zero calls; separate known usage, unknown usage and estimated cost.
